items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1959-12-09
items.q: Yeah, rich fellas from Alexander, old man, Wade, Bred Clark, and Charlie Clark.

ctx.x: You were talking about those trips you made in the rich guys that hired the band?

Yeah, rich fellas from Alexander, old man, Wade, Bred Clark, and Charlie Clark. They picked up old man, Dr. Williams in Monroe. He was a flute player, you know, in his early days. He's a rich man too, Dr. Williams, and he loved that band we had. It was a good band, you know. He said, well boys, we're going to give you all a chance to make some money. So they had a lot of old fellas, old sawmill men, you know, on the train. I didn't know them so well, the more than what they told me. But they had to sleep, you…
